notes:
ワンピース (from English "one-piece") refers to a casual, everyday dress—a one-piece garment for women. This is distinct from ⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧, which implies formal attire.

Common types:
- ⟦シャツワンピース→シャツワンピース：noentry⟧ (shirt dress)
- ⟦マキシワンピース→マキシワンピース：noentry⟧ (maxi dress)
- ⟦ニットワンピース→ニットワンピース：noentry⟧ (knit dress)
- ⟦ノースリーブワンピース→ノースリーブワンピース：noentry⟧ (sleeveless dress)

Distinction from ドレス:
- ワンピース: casual, everyday wear
- ⟦ドレス→ドレス：00037_doresu⟧: formal, party or wedding attire

Note: In swimwear, ワンピース refers to a one-piece swimsuit (vs. ⟦ビキニ→ビキニ：27421_bikini⟧).
